entities.name: László Ocskay
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: László Jenő Ocskay of Ocskó and Felsődubován (1893–1966) was a Hungarian army officer, captain of the Royal Hungarian Army. He saved approximately 2500 Jews in Budapest in 1944–45, thus being one of those Hungarians who saved the most Jews during the Holocaust.

entities.summary: László Jenő Ocskay of Ocskó and Felsődubován (1893–1966) was a Hungarian army officer, captain of the Royal Hungarian Army. He saved approximately 2500 Jews in Budapest in 1944–45, thus being one of those Hungarians who saved the most Jews during the Holocaust.
